description: Every page of the site with clicks, impressions, CTR, position, trend, page category (winner, zero click, high impressions low CTR, declining, cannibalized, not indexable) and recommended action. Uses your connected Google Search Console (read-only) plus a crawl of the site; the analysis is reused for a day. Never changes your site: redirects are proposals only. Needs an API key from a paid plan.
